add_locations.name: jo9_gameover_audio
add_locations.body:
! JO9 MOD START GAMEOVER_AUDIO_SCREEN_ONLY_20261108
if $args[0]='enter':
 if jo9_gameover_audio_active=1: exit
 jo9_gameover_audio_active=1
 $music_now='content/snd/gameoverbgm.mp3'
 if sound_on=1:
  play 'content/snd/gameoverbgm.mp3',music_volume,'only, loop'
  play 'content/snd/gameover.wav',sound_volume
 end
 exit
end
if $args[0]='leave':
 if $args[1]='exit' or jo9_gameover_audio_active!1: exit
 jo9_gameover_audio_active=0
 close 'content/snd/gameoverbgm.mp3'
 close 'content/snd/gameover.wav'
 if $music_now='content/snd/gameoverbgm.mp3': $music_now=''
 exit
end
if $args[0]='load':
 jo9_gameover_audio_active=0
 if $args[1]='exit': gs 'jo9_gameover_audio','enter' & exit
 if $music_now='content/snd/gameoverbgm.mp3': $music_now=''
 if sound_on=1 and $music_now!'':
  play $music_now,music_volume,'only, loop'
 else
  close 'content/snd/gameoverbgm.mp3'
  close 'content/snd/gameover.wav'
 end
end
! JO9 MOD END GAMEOVER_AUDIO_SCREEN_ONLY_20261108
